Welcome to the 2026-2027 PWHL Fantasy League hosted by Alex & Noah!

To confirm your registration in the League, please follow these steps:

1. Draft your Fantasy team in the [PWHL Fantasy League Google Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sywjZ6quCmbLBq_wEEXZEDzcW0NeBpCtRaT3W1hDkhI/edit?gid=352060853#gid=352060853). The rules for drafting are [found below](#drafting-rules) as well as in the Sheet.

2. Once your Fantasy team is drafted, complete your registration in the [PWHL Fantasy League Google Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdLuJngQUMY0km7S_Yoe5BkwwL0EfbxKcW5VNdztRjFvk0X6A/viewform?usp=preview).

🕐 **Deadline:** You can use all of November's pre-season games to scout your roster and aim to lock it in by **December 1st, 2026**! After this date, the Google Sheet will be 👁️**View Only**👁️<br>

::: {.callout-warning}
The 2026-2027 PWHL Roster in the Google Sheet is not a live roster and has to be updated manually. This means that some of the roster info may be subject to change if any were to occur in the actual PWHL rosters, for example, if a trade or a new signing occurs. The Google Sheet will be updated on November 24th and again on December 1st. If the December 1st refresh causes issues with any of the drafted teams, we will make sure your intentions are still reflected in your drafted team.
:::

🏆 **Prize pool:** We are introducing an optional 50/50 prize pool for the Fantasy League this year. For all of the money included in the prize pool, 50% of that amount will go to the winner of the Fantasy League and 50% will go to the [Ottawa Humane Society](https://www.ottawahumane.ca/). The prize pool is optional however if you don't contribute you are not eligible to win the 50/50. If you wish to participate, e-transfer $10 to Noah at **noah.bolohan@gmail.com** before you complete your response to the Google Form.

🤔 **Questions:** Text or email Alex or Noah (noah.bolohan@gmail.com) if you need any help making a team or have any questions.

# Drafting rules

Your team should have exactly the following (the Google Sheet dropdowns force this structure, don't worry!):<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;**🏒 6 forwards**<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;**🛡️ 4 defenders**<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;**🥅 2 goalies**<br>

💰 Each draftable PWHL player has been assigned a **Fantasy Draft Value (FDV)**. The sum of all of your drafted players' FDVs cannot exceed the value cap of 300 (the Google Sheet will track this for you). You can read about how the FDVs are assigned [here](https://alex-and-noah.github.io/pwhl-fantasy-league/fantasy_draft_data.html) and you can explore all the draftable players and their FDVs [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sywjZ6quCmbLBq_wEEXZEDzcW0NeBpCtRaT3W1hDkhI/edit?gid=1969641849#gid=1969641849).

😮‍💨 Players/goalies aren't restricted to a single fantasy team so if someone took a player you like, you can take them too!

↔️ **Trades:** Throughout the season, you are allowed **exactly 1 trade** (respecting the team structure and salary cap). Your new player only contributes points to your fantasy score starting the day after the trade. Please **let Alex or Noah know directly** if/when you make a trade!<br><br>

# Scoring
Your fantasy team's score is updated daily with data from the previous day's games. Each day, each member of your fantasy roster will contribute a number of points to your team's overall score, following the scheme below:

| Skaters        | Goalies |
| ------------- |-------------|
| 🏒 2 pts/goal<br>🤝 1 pt/assist<br>🎯 0.1 pts/shot<br>⛔ 0.1 pts/blocked shot<br>✨ 2 pts/any win\*<br>😖 0 pts/loss\*<br>🥇 1 pt/OT loss\*      | 🧱 1 pt/shutout<br>⛔ 0.05 pts/save<br>✨ 2 pts/any win\*<br>😖 0 pts/loss\*<br>🥇 1 pt/OT loss\* |

\*Note that if your play did not play in a game in which their team won, they will *not* contribute points to your score (this includes dressed goalies that did not get subbed in).

You can check how your and everyone else's teams are doing [here](./team_standings.qmd). Note that eventually, only **regular season games** will contribute to your fantasy teams score.
